title: Quiz: Async and Concurrency
description: Check your understanding of Async and Concurrency.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Python?
questions.explanation: In Python, # marks a comment. Block comments use # (line comments only).

questions.question: What problem does async programming solve?
options: Long-running tasks without freezing the program
questions.correctAnswer: Long-running tasks without freezing the program
questions.explanation: Async lets slow operations happen in the background.

questions.question: True or False: undefined
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: await fetch(url)  // wait for ___ to finish
questions.explanation: Await suspends until the async result arrives.

questions.question: In Python, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
